title: The job you forgot
story: Yesterday you started an interactive job with 4 GPUs and closed your laptop without typing exit. It's still holding the GPUs, and the server is full. Find that job, cancel it, then start a fresh 1-GPU session.

tasks.text: Start an interactive job with 1 GPU

hints: `squeue --me` shows your jobs and their IDs. `scancel ID` ends one.
